messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED — GPU OOM spikes on livestage pool (node-gn02). Auto page created. Priority: P1. Affected: serving-runtime v3.4.4 (livestage).

sam: seeing this on dashboards — 10% of requests started failing with CUDA OOM despite headroom reported. rolling alert at 2468001220.

jin: curious — headroom metric shows ~1.2GB free on the GPU when the OOM happens. logs show allocator failure after a large prefetch.

sam: exact error from runtime:
```
E CUDA: out of memory while allocating 524288000 bytes
E allocator: reserve_block_claim failed: block already pinned
E kv-cache: failed to evict prefix, reserved_blocks in-use=42
```

tim-oncall: oncall here. quick question — is this the livestage prefetch experiment? we enabled aggressive prefetch on that pool yesterday.

ops-lela: yes, we turned on prefetch=aggressive for livestage to reduce latency tail. suspect prefetch thrash is pinning reserve blocks and preventing eviction.

maria-rte: customers saw elevated 5xx for ~3m starting 2468001228. we need mitigation now, any quick mitigations?

sam: mitigation plan: 1) disable prefetch on livestage pool 2) drain traffic to fallback model variant 3) restart affected containers to clear pinned reserves. doing steps in that order.

jin: +1. also I'm running a quick script to list pinned reserve blocks and oldest holder:
```bash
curl -s http://node-gn02.metrics/reserve | jq .pinned_blocks | sort -k2 -n | head -n 10
# shows many pinned by prefetch_worker:prefetch-12
```

tim-oncall: disabling prefetch now. command: `/infra run update-pool --pool=livestage --prefetch=off`

ops-lela: running the command, patch ID infra/3456, rolling to 3 nodes.

incident-bot: Action logged: pool update submitted by tim-oncall at 2468001254.

sam: starting traffic drain from node-gn02 to fallback (lower-capacity) pool. healthchecks will keep half the capacity until restarted.

jin: snapshot of allocator stats right before restart:
```
allocator.allocated=15.4GB
allocator.reserved=6.0GB
allocator.free_headroom=1.1GB
pinned_blocks.count=42
pinned_blocks.top=4096MB pinned by prefetch_worker:prefetch-12
```

maria-rte: customers are being notified. CC: account-sre. status page updated. :white_check_mark:

ops-lela: nodes patched, prefetch off applied. waiting for drain to complete then will restart containers.

tim-oncall: once node restarted, check KV cache metrics — we suspect stale kv-cache entries preventing prefix eviction. also verify reserve counters reset.

sam: restarting container on node-gn02 (pod serving-runtime-gn02-7f9c). command: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/serving-runtime -n livestage --field-selector=spec.nodeName=node-gn02`

incident-bot: Restart initiated at 2468001299.

jin: after restart, reserve counters dropped to pinned_blocks.count=2 and allocator.free_headroom=3.7GB. no immediate OOMs.

sam: traffic restored to node-gn02. 5xxs back to normal. monitoring for 15m.

maria-rte: customer impact window logged: 2468001228-2468001315 (~1m27s of elevated errors). exporting list of affected request ids to support.

jin: root cause hypothesis: aggressive prefetch created many in-flight prefetches that allocated reserved blocks but were never properly released because eviction path hit a race with the KV cache eviction callback. when headroom check runs it looked OK (free_headroom > threshold) but pinned blocks still blocked large contiguous allocs leading to OOM on big inputs. fragmentation + pinned-reserve => allocation failure.

ops-lela: short-term patch: disable prefetch for >24h on pools with <N GPUs or with heavy kv-cache usage. ops ticket OPS-788 created.

tim-oncall: next actions for postmortem: 1) add a metric for pinned_blocks.age to surface stuck pins 2) add allocator assertion to log owners and backtraces on reserve claim failures 3) revert prefetch experiment flags and add canary gating 4) run fragmentation sweep job weekly. assigning owners.

maria-rte: assigning: jin -> allocator logs and eviction race investigation, sam -> deployment gating + rollback docs, ops-lela -> runbook update + prefetch experiment checklist.

sam: fyi adding a short-term runtime guard: fail prefetch allocation if reserved_blocks.count > 30 to avoid this class of failure. will roll to staging first.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED by tim-oncall at 2468001367. Summary: temporary customer errors, mitigations applied, follow-ups created.

maria-rte: good job team — please add timeline and blameless postmortem in #postmortems when done. :thumbsup:

jin: will include sample logs and the failing stack traces in the postmortem.

sam: tagging this for Optimize and runtime teams.

ops-lela: adding runbook entry: 'prefetch -> pinned reserve OOM' and link to OPS-788.

tim-oncall: closing thread. anyone still seeing anomalies ping me.
